claim_1.claim: Serum bactericidal assay analysis of blood serum from 20 healthy adults vaccinated with either MenACWY-CRM or MenACWY-PS showed that the first vaccine dose elicited increased MenA- and MenC-specific SBA geometric mean titres 28 days after vaccination in all groups, while a subsequent MenACWY-CRM dose did not induce a further rise in SBA titres; no statistically significant differences in MenA or MenC SBA geometric mean titres were observed between the four vaccine groups after either dose.

sources.quote: The first dose of either MenACWY-CRM or MenACWY-PS elicited a rise in SBA geometric mean titres (GMTs) against MenA and MenC 28 days post-vaccination for all groups (Fig. 1a).
The second dose did not induce a further rise in SBA titres as GMTs 28 days after the first and second dose were comparable.
No statistically significant differences were seen in MenA or MenC SBA GMTs between the four vaccine groups after the first or second dose of vaccine (Fig. 1a).
Serum samples collected at days 0, 28 and 56 were assessed for human SBA activity against serogroup A (F8238) and serogroup C (C11).

claim_2.claim: Transcription profiling by array analysis of whole blood from healthy adults vaccinated with MenACWY-CRM or MenACWY-PS showed that 7 days after the initial MenACWY vaccine dose, all four vaccine groups combined had differential expression of five transcripts LOC651751 (Ig kappa chain V-II region), LOC642113(IGKV3D-20), LOC649923, CDKN2D and  LOC100131905 compared with baseline, including three transcripts annotated as antibody segments, while 7 days after the second MenACWY-CRM dose, a larger and distinct set of 448 transcripts was differentially expressed.

sources.quote: Given the hierarchical clustering and the significant overlap in gene regulation, as well as the small number of participants per group, we explored differentially transcript expression by combining all four vaccine groups (Fig. 3a).

In this combined analysis, five transcripts were differentially expressed, three of which were annotated as antibody segments: LOC651751 (Ig kappa chain V-II region), LOC642113 (IGKV3D-20) and LOC649923.

Differential transcript expression and associated p values following quadrivalent meningococcal vaccine (all groups combined). a Seven days after the initial dose of MenACWY. b Seven days after a second dose of MenACWY.

Seven days following the second vaccination (MenACWY-CRM), 448 transcripts were differentially expressed; this represents a notable enrichment of differentially expressed transcript (DETs) compared with 7 days following the initial dose of vaccine.
